Impute missing abundances

step_impute.Rd

Use glyclean::auto_impute() or select an impute_* function by its suffix. The imputed experiment becomes the input to the next step.

Usage

step_impute(
  method = c("auto", "zero", "sample_min", "half_sample_min", "sw_knn", "fw_knn", "bpca",
    "ppca", "svd", "min_prob", "miss_forest", "dreamai"),
  ...,
  dreamai_methods = NULL
)

Arguments

method

Imputation method. "auto" selects by experiment type and sample count. Explicit methods are "zero", "sample_min", "half_sample_min", "sw_knn", "fw_knn", "bpca", "ppca", "svd", "min_prob", "miss_forest" and "dreamai". DreamAI requires a glyclean installation that exports impute_dreamai().

...

Arguments for the selected glyclean function, such as k for nearest-neighbor imputation, or by, q, tune.sigma and seed for glyclean::impute_min_prob().

dreamai_methods

Components passed to the DreamAI ensemble's method argument. The default uses glyclean's choice of components.

Value

A glysmith_step object.

Examples

step_impute("half_sample_min")
#> <step "step_impute(\"half_sample_min\")"> Impute missing abundances
#> (half_sample_min)
step_impute("min_prob", by = "group", q = 0.02, seed = 42)
#> <step "step_impute(\"min_prob\", by = \"group\", q = 0.02, seed = 42)"> Impute
#> missing abundances (min_prob)
